question: The Sunderbans Biosphere Reserve is located in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**West Bengal**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Sunderbans Tiger Reserve is in** West Bengal.**__
 
• Project Tiger is a tiger conservation program launched in April 1973 by the Government of India.
 
• Nagpur is also known as the** ‘Tiger Capital’ of India**
 
• The Sundarbans is a** delta formed by the Ganges, Brahmaputra, and Meghna rivers.** 
 
• The Sundarbans **is known for its Bengal tigers. **
 
• **T**he Sundarbans was designated a UNESCO biosphere reserve in 2001. 
 
• The Sundarbans is part of the world's largest delta.
